checks: test_uncertain_intent_never_rebinds_to_send_again requires the durable dispatch-intent marker to match the endpoint binding and blocks restart
test_other_uncertain_unit_blocks_endpoint_rebinding rejects a foreign active admission marker before endpoint mutation
test_existing_intent_default_refuses_without_dispatch_or_service_writes preserves an existing intent with no command, dispatch, service write, or result
test_networkless_topology accepts only the exact worker/proxy network topology read back from the fixture
test_networkless_rejects_unsafe_changes rejects changed network identity, host access, privilege, and mount topology
test_networkless_rejects_other_shared_namespaces rejects host and foreign PID/IPC/cgroup namespaces
test_cli_refuses_external_signing_destination_before_key_access requires an explicit private loopback listener identity before key access
test_uncertain_existing_work_blocks_new_task rejects unresolved WorkUnit state before a new binding or restart
test_uncertain_intent_never_rebinds_to_send_again prevents restart while the original dispatch outcome is uncertain
test_cli_observe_only_collects_original_without_orchestrate_or_service_restart observes the original without a service restart
ProbeTests.test_bypassed_guard_cannot_pass rejects substituted source archive, diff, signature, and prebuilt artifact
ProbeTests.test_unrelated_value_error_cannot_pass and test_unrelated_command_or_signature_config_failure_cannot_pass prevent unrelated failures from counting as rejection
test_actual_http_response_loss_reconciles_without_second_validation reconciles the original signed receipt without replaying validation

execution_boundary.network: fresh empty user/network namespace with loopback only for every recorded pytest invocation

preservation_boundary.evidence: Every pytest invocation ran in a fresh empty network namespace and used deterministic local fixtures. The process made no NUC, Docker, provider, or production contact, so the 189 tracked NUC WorkUnits and retained probe directories were not touched. This isolation evidence is stronger than an unverifiable remote claim here; no live WorkUnit inventory was read or changed.

interpretation: This is fixture-backed admission/readiness qualification only. It does not launch the corrected NUC probe, install or activate a release, alter firewall/shared services, execute a prebuilt wall control against Docker, accept a live receipt, or establish production readiness.
